description: blastema probability threshold in each end thumbnail before back-projection
smoothing 1: Gaussian blur (px of thumbnail) of the binary blastema, re-thresholded at 0.5
smoothing 2: Gaussian blur of the final mask in the added zone, fraction of the worm length L
convex hull guard: pixels gained by the hull are kept only where the blastema probability is at least this value
morphological opening of the added blastema, disc radius as a fraction of L (removes structures narrower than 0.06 L)
contact rule: an added piece is kept if (pixels touching the mask) / sqrt(area) >= this value
expert annotation: minimum annotated area (px) for the annotation to replace the model output
reproduce the production file format: the refined mask is saved as JPEG quality 100 and read back by the cascade, composite and descriptors
